import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.datasets import make_classification

X, y = make_classification(n_samples=500, n_features=2, n_redundant=0,
                           n_clusters_per_class=2, n_classes=2)

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
plt.scatter(X[:, 0], X[:, 1], c=y, cmap='coolwarm')
plt.show()

from sklearn.naive_bayes import GaussianNB
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
import time
from sklearn import metrics

klasyfikatory = {
    "Gauss": GaussianNB(),
    "QDA": QuadraticDiscriminantAnalysis(),
    "KNN": KNeighborsClassifier(),
    "SVC": SVC(probability=True),
    "Tree": DecisionTreeClassifier()
}

results = []
last_predictions = {}

for name, clf in klasyfikatory.items():
    scores = {
        'accuracy_score': [],
        'recall_score': [],
        'precision_score': [],
        'f1_score': [],
        'roc_auc': [],
        'train_time': [],
        'test_time': []
    }

    for i in range(100):
        X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, stratify=y)

        start_train = time.time()
        clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
        end_train = time.time()

        start_test = time.time()
        y_pred = clf.predict(X_test)
        y_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
        end_test = time.time()

        scores['accuracy_score'].append(metrics.accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred))
        scores['recall_score'].append(metrics.recall_score(y_test, y_pred))
        scores['precision_score'].append(metrics.precision_score(y_test, y_pred))
        scores['f1_score'].append(metrics.f1_score(y_test, y_pred))
        scores['roc_auc'].append(metrics.roc_auc_score(y_test, y_proba))
        scores['train_time'].append(end_train - start_train)
        scores['test_time'].append(end_test - start_test)

        if i == 99:  # ostatnia iteracja
            last_predictions[name] = (y_test.copy(), y_pred.copy())

    averaged = {metric: np.mean(values) for metric, values in scores.items()}
    averaged['classifier'] = name
    results.append(averaged)

df_results = pd.DataFrame(results)

x = np.arange(len(scores))
width = 0.15
kolory = ['blue', 'orange', 'green', 'red', 'purple']

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 6))

for idx, clf in enumerate(df_results['classifier']):
    values = [df_results.loc[idx, metric] for metric in scores]
    plt.bar(x + idx * width, values, width=width, label=clf, color=kolory[idx])
    
plt.xticks(x + width * 2, scores.keys())
plt.ylabel('Wartość')
plt.legend(title='Klasyfikator')
plt.show()

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

name = "Tree"
y_test, y_pred = last_predictions[name]
X_train, X_test_plot, y_train, _ = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, stratify=y)

X_test_2D = X_test_plot[:, :2]
errors = (y_test != y_pred)

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 4))
plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)
plt.title("oczekiwane")
plt.scatter(X_test_2D[:, 0], X_test_2D[:, 1], c=y_test, cmap='coolwarm', edgecolor='k', alpha=0.8)
plt.axis('equal')

plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)
plt.title("obliczone")
plt.scatter(X_test_2D[:, 0], X_test_2D[:, 1], c=y_pred, cmap='coolwarm', edgecolor='k', alpha=0.8)
plt.axis('equal')

plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)
plt.title("różnice")
for i in range(len(y_test)):
    color = 'red' if errors[i] else 'green'
    plt.scatter(X_test_2D[i, 0], X_test_2D[i, 1], color=color, edgecolor='k', alpha=0.9)
plt.axis('equal')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))

for name, clf in klasyfikatory.items():
    y_test, _ = last_predictions[name]
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, stratify=y)
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
    y_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1] 

    fpr, tpr, thresholds = roc_curve(y_test, y_proba)
    roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)

    plt.plot(fpr, tpr, lw=2, label=f'{name} (AUC = {roc_auc:.2f})')

plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], color='gray', linestyle='--') 
plt.title('Krzywe ROC dla klasyfikatorów (ostatnia iteracja)')
plt.legend(loc='lower right')
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from sklearn.datasets import make_classification
from sklearn.model_selection import GridSearchCV, train_test_split
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

X, y = make_classification(
    n_samples=500, 
    n_features=2, 
    n_informative=2,  
    n_redundant=0,    
    n_repeated=0,
    n_classes=2, 
    random_state=42
)
X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=42)

knn = KNeighborsClassifier()
param_grid = {
    'n_neighbors': list(range(1, 16)), 
    'p': [1, 2]                       
}

grid_search = GridSearchCV(knn, param_grid, scoring='roc_auc', cv=5)
grid_search.fit(X_train, y_train)

y_proba = grid_search.best_estimator_.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
print("ROC AUC na zbiorze testowym:", roc_auc_score(y_test, y_proba))

ROC AUC na zbiorze testowym: 0.9806801994301994

results = grid_search.cv_results_
params = results['params']
scores = results['mean_test_score']
df = pd.DataFrame(params)
df['score'] = scores

df_p2 = df[df['p'] == 2]

plt.figure(figsize=(12, 5))

plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
plt.plot(df_p2['n_neighbors'], df_p2['score'], marker='o')
plt.xlabel('Liczba sąsiadów (n_neighbors)')
plt.ylabel('Accuracy')

p_vals = sorted(df['p'].unique())
n_vals = sorted(df['n_neighbors'].unique())

score_matrix = np.zeros((len(p_vals), len(n_vals)))

for idx, row in df.iterrows():
    i = p_vals.index(row['p'])
    j = n_vals.index(row['n_neighbors'])
    score_matrix[i, j] = row['score']

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
im = plt.imshow(score_matrix, aspect='auto', cmap='viridis',
                extent=[n_vals[0], n_vals[-1], p_vals[0], p_vals[-1]],
                origin='lower')
plt.colorbar(im, label='Accuracy (CV)')
plt.xticks(n_vals)
plt.yticks(p_vals)
plt.xlabel('Liczba sąsiadów (n_neighbors)')
plt.ylabel('Parametr metryki p')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

best_params = grid_search.best_params_
print("Najlepsze parametry:", best_params)
accuracies = []
for _ in range(100):
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=None  
    )

    clf = KNeighborsClassifier(**best_params)
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
    
    y_pred = clf.predict(X_test)
    acc = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
    accuracies.append(acc)

mean_acc = np.mean(accuracies)
std_acc = np.std(accuracies)

print(f"Średnia Accuracy (z 100 podziałów): {mean_acc:.4f}")
print(f"Odchylenie standardowe: {std_acc:.4f}")

from sklearn.metrics import (
    accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score,
    roc_auc_score, roc_curve
)
best_params = grid_search.best_params_
print("Najlepsze parametry:", best_params)

results = []
for i in range(100):
    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X, y, test_size=0.3, random_state=None
    )
    
    clf = KNeighborsClassifier(**best_params)

    start_train = time.time()
    clf.fit(X_train, y_train)
    end_train = time.time()

    start_test = time.time()
    y_pred = clf.predict(X_test)
    y_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    end_test = time.time()

    acc = accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred)
    recall = recall_score(y_test, y_pred)
    precision = precision_score(y_test, y_pred)
    f1 = f1_score(y_test, y_pred)
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_test, y_proba)

    results.append({
        'accuracy': acc,
        'recall': recall,
        'precision': precision,
        'f1': f1,
        'auc': auc,
        'train_time': end_train - start_train,
        'test_time': end_test - start_test
    })

    if i == 99:
        fpr, tpr, thresholds = roc_curve(y_test, y_proba)
        X_test_last = X_test
        y_test_last = y_test
        y_pred_last = y_pred

df_results = pd.DataFrame(results)
print("Średnie wyniki:\n", df_results.mean())

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f"AUC = {roc_auc_score(y_test_last, y_proba):.2f}")
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', lw=1)
plt.xlabel("False Positive Rate")
plt.ylabel("True Positive Rate")
plt.title("Krzywa ROC – ostatnia iteracja")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

x_min, x_max = X_test_last[:, 0].min() - 1, X_test_last[:, 0].max() + 1
y_min, y_max = X_test_last[:, 1].min() - 1, X_test_last[:, 1].max() + 1
xx, yy = np.meshgrid(np.arange(x_min, x_max, h),
                     np.arange(y_min, y_max, h))
Z = clf.predict(np.c_[xx.ravel(), yy.ravel()])
Z = Z.reshape(xx.shape)

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
plt.contourf(xx, yy, Z, alpha=0.3)
plt.scatter(X_test_last[:, 0], X_test_last[:, 1], c=y_test_last,  edgecolors='k')
plt.title("Granica decyzyjna – ostatnia iteracja")
plt.xlabel("Cecha 1")
plt.ylabel("Cecha 2")
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()

Wysoka skuteczność klasyfikatora: Klasyfikator k-NN z k=9 i metryką Euklidesową osiągnął bardzo dobre wyniki – szczególnie pod względem AUC (97.81%), co oznacza dużą zdolność do rozróżniania klas pozytywnych i negatywnych.

Zrównoważone metryki: Wysokie wartości precision (95.64%) i recall (92.01%) wskazują, że model jest zarówno precyzyjny (mało fałszywych alarmów), jak i czuły (wykrywa większość przypadków klasy pozytywnej).

Niska złożoność obliczeniowa: Czas trenowania i testowania jest bardzo niski, co sprawia, że k-NN z dobranymi parametrami świetnie sprawdza się w małych i średnich zbiorach danych.
